research_rationale: Withdraw the exact December 31, 1992 first-end assignments. The independent review correctly distinguishes the not-later-than bound from an actual termination date. EO12815 changes only the date in EO12813 section 4(b), retaining the qualifier. EO12869 formally revokes effective September 30, 1993 but does not supply the earlier actual terminal date. All eight Commission-dependent scopes remain in the inventory; no later formal-revocation date replaces an unknown earlier first end. Accrued travel and procurement liabilities remain residual questions, not evidence of a new independent Commission mandate.
unresolved_material_gaps: EO12815 substitutes December 31, 1992 into the original not-later-than clause; this proves an outer termination bound, not an exact first cessation for all eight functions. Actual cessation evidence is unheld.
